name: Bacterial leaf blight
signs: Water-soaked stripes along the leaf edges that turn yellow, then white or gray
Bacterial ooze, sometimes visible as droplets in the early morning
actions: Avoid overhead irrigation splash and excess nitrogen
Remove and destroy heavily infected plant residue, away from the field
Use resistant varieties in future seasons
callExpertIf: It is spreading across the whole field or the leaves are drying out quickly
